subset: Every GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE operation whose path is: /users, /users/delta(), /users/{user-id} or /me, and under either one of the segments messages, mailFolders, sendMail, events, calendar, calendars, calendarView, drive, drives, chats, joinedTeams, presence, mailboxSettings; anything under /teams, /chats, /drives, /subscriptions; /sites, its functions, /sites/{site-id} and its drive, drives and sites; /communications/presences and /communications/getPresencesByUserId. Left out under all of these: the Excel (workbook), SharePoint list (list, listItem) and analytics sub-APIs.
